jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on a range of projects and with different teams? Do you want to be part of an innovative & people orientated company? Then MRN
could be the one for you!

About MRN

At MRN, our focus is on increasing accessibility to clinical trials for a diverse population of patients. We achieve this by utilizing the Decentralized Clinical Trial (DCT) model, which involves conducting trials directly in the patient's communities. For decentralized trials to be accessible to all patients, it's essential to have a diverse workforce. A diverse workforce brings various perspectives and experiences that can help identify and address potential participation barriers. At MRN, we value diversity and want to hear from people who represent our diverse patient population.

About the role…

We are now looking for a talented Project Manager
to join our team. As a Project Manager
, you will deliver MRN projects on time and within budget, and in accordance with international laws and guidelines

The Project Manager
will be responsible for:
Part of study team to include, Operations, Nursing, Vendor Contracts Management Team (VCMT), proposals and contracts (P&C), Pharmacy and Quality staff to plan, manage, track and monitor projects to ensure they are delivered on time and within budget, in compliance with MRN procedures and applicable regulations
Supported by the Project Management Office (PMO) provide accurate and timely information to the Project Management Group Head (PMGH), Project Director (PD), PM, clients and sponsors on overall project performance including both financial and operational aspects
Undertake activities as described below and participate in specific activities as defined in MRN RACI or appropriate study delivery plan/ study activities
Create and implement individual plan(s) for assigned project(s), as applicable, to include an assessment of potential risks to the project delivery and a contingency plan. Use tools such as MS-Project and the service detail specification Manage and participate in internal and external kick off meetings, with understanding of study objectives and customer requirements
Drive cross-functional project activities, as appropriate in the study delivery plan
Use study metrics to track and report activities, risks internally and externally (including governance meetings)
Study close-out and archiving according to MRN and any sponsor specific requirements

Skills, Experience, and Qualifications...

We are looking for talented individuals who have working knowledge of ICH GCP and appropriate regulatory laws and guidelines. Individuals who have the ability to multi-task, problem solve and priorities a complex workload is a must.
We are interested to hear from individuals with the following experience:

Essential:

Minimum 3 years (4-5 years desirable) relevant experience to include sponsor/CRO, and or site clinical research experience
Proven effectiveness in leading a cross functional teams/ matrix management experience
Proven experience in planning and delivering projects on time and to budget

Desirable:

Degree level education, or nursing equivalent, science/medical based subjects

Where:
This role will be office/home based (remote and hybrid working options are available).
Contract Type:
This is a Full-Time position

Why Join us?

At MRN we offer a number of benefits designed to promote your work-life balance and make your time at MRN enjoyable and rewarding. We encourage all our employees to be ambitious, and offer great training, mentoring and career development opportunities.

Our core benefits include:
generous paid leave (including an additional day off for your birthday)
medical and life insurance cover
pension / 401(k) scheme
bonus scheme

We also know how important health and wellbeing are and offer free independent 24/7 help and advice for work and home related challenges: as well as physical wellbeing support and online 24/7 access to healthcare professionals. MRN respect people’s different working preferences and the need for a healthy work-life balance and offer flexible working hours and remote working.

So, what's next…
If this sounds like you and you’d like to learn more, we would love to hear from you! Please click ‘Apply Now’ or email careers@themrn.co.uk.

MRN is proud to be an equal opportunities employer

We are an equal opportunity employer who values diversity. Our aim is to work simultaneously to promote a more inclusive and safer environment for everyone, which attracts all candidates and portrays our commitment to celebrate and promote diversity. Our aim is to ensure your application, interview process and transition to MRN is simple and personal. If you require any adjustments for any part of the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please get in touch.

Data Protection - Your Rights

Should you apply for a job opportunity at the MRN, we wish to inform you that it is our intention to retain the personal data provided by you for up to 2 years from the date it is received, at which point you will be asked to provide new consent. If you have any questions or concerns regarding our processes and how your personal data will be stored, please contact us for further reassurance.

DBS Disclosure

DBS Disclosure may be requested in the event of being offered the position. Having a criminal record will not necessarily prevent you from working with us. This will depend on the nature of the position and the circumstances and background of the offence(s).

jobs.description:
Senior Bridge Project Manager

Fought & Company | Remote (U.S.) | Full-Time

Position Overview

Fought & Company is seeking an experienced Senior Bridge Project Manager
to help drive the continued growth of one of the West Coast's premier bridge and heavy fabrication programs. Based in the Pacific Northwest, Fought is strategically focused on complex bridge structures, heavy plate fabrication, railroad bridges, and infrastructure that strengthens America's transportation network.

This position may be 100% remote
for the right candidate.

We are looking for a bridge builder.

Fought & Company is expanding its Bridge & Heavy Fabrication team and seeking a Senior Bridge Project Manager with deep experience delivering complex steel bridge projects across the Pacific Northwest.

This is not an entry point into bridge work. We are looking for someone who knows the industry, understands the DOT environment, has managed significant bridge projects, and can anticipate problems before they become problems.

Qualifications

The right person will bring:
Significant steel bridge project management experience
A long history working in the Pacific Northwest bridge market
Deep understanding of owners, general contractors, schedules, contracts, fabrication, erection, and project risk
The judgment and confidence to lead complicated projects and difficult conversations
Strong relationships and a reputation for doing what they say they will do

Compensation

$165,000 - $185,000 annually, DOE. Final offer will depend on experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

Why Fought

At Fought, we believe great projects are built by great people. We invest in relationships, embrace complex challenges, and pursue continuous improvement every day. Fought is building something different: a bridge-focused organization with significant fabrication capacity, a growing Western footprint, and the ambition to become the premier outsourced Bridge & Heavy Fabrication partner in the West. If you have spent your career building bridges in the PNW and believe your experience can help us build what comes next, we should talk.

Opportunity Grows Here.

Email us at grit@foughtsteel.com

jobs.title: Project Manager - Medical Communications
jobs.description:
About Lockwood:
Lockwood collaborates with clients in the pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device industries to identify effective, holistic, science-based strategies to address their objectives through medical communications. Our clients count on us to challenge their assumptions and help them creatively navigate around obstacles. From strategy through execution, we focus on accuracy, transparency, and scientific value to create programs that are evidence-based, clinically relevant, and contribute to the development of our clients' brands. Over a third of our staff hold advanced scientific or medical degrees, and most work from where they live. Because our flexible structure provides better work-life balance, we attract the best talent, facilitate their best work, and as a result, are more responsive to our clients, wherever and whenever they do business.

Summary:
In this role, the Project Manager is responsible for managing all aspects of medical communications projects from inception to completion, including but not limited to, content development, advisory boards, and speaker training.

Responsibilities include facilitating multidisciplinary project teams, interfacing with each department within the company, meeting client and management expectations, establishing strong faculty relationships, and ensuring programs remain on target and within agreed-upon parameters. The Project Manager is responsible for budget development, maintenance and reconciliation, managing external suppliers, keeping programs on time and focused on primary objectives, providing ongoing updates to internal team members and client contact(s), and resource management. The number of simultaneous programs managed by each Project Manager is dependent on the scope and nature of each initiative.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional communicator with experience successfully leading multidisciplinary teams. We are seeking individuals with strong financial management skills who are highly organized, adept at multitasking/prioritizing, and have the ability and willingness to motivate others.

Responsibilities:

Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and faculty members
Maintain and manage timely and professional written and verbal communications with clients and faculty members
Ensure client expectations are met on all levels of program activity
Establish and maintain a strong knowledge of client organizations, products, disease states, and medical education
Develop new project budgets
Contribute to new business development activities within the account team
Manage budgeting, financial monitoring, and reconciliation of individual projects
Schedule and conduct start-up, interim, and final team meetings for each project, establish and maintain time and events schedules, and provide ongoing updates to client and team as required by account team on each initiative to ensure successful management and completion
Facilitate progress of multidisciplinary project teams to ensure within-budget, on-time, on-strategy performance
Own the detail of daily account work on each project
Oversee and facilitate development of all project activities, including faculty recruitment and ongoing communication, audience generation, content development, logistics management, registration/participant communication, production of materials, supplier performance, central file management
Assist in training new account team members as required
Maintain company policies as they pertain to all activities
Adhere to all Lockwood Group policies and standard operating procedures

Education:
A bachelor's degree is required.

Professional Skills & Experience:
Three to five years of relevant project management experience in a healthcare communications environment is required. Candidates must have the ability to grasp and retain scientific information, along with a strong technical aptitude and working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Access.

This position can be performed remotely in all but the following locations: Colorado, New York City, San Francisco County, CA.

A growing project and development management consulting firm based in Raleigh, North Carolina is seeking a Project Manager to oversee a variety of healthcare and commercial development and construction projects from planning through completion. This role offers the opportunity to work directly with clients, consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders while managing projects across multiple industries and market sectors.

* Manage projects through planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.

Quantum ERP Solutions | Remote (US) | Full time

We're hiring an Epicor Project Manager to lead Kinetic implementations for our manufacturing and distribution clients.
Quantum ERP Solutions is an Epicor Certified Partner based in Laguna Beach, California. We're a growing team of consultants who deliver implementations, upgrades, and optimization work for manufacturers and distributors across the country. Our tagline is simple: Work Together. Grow Together.
What you'll do

You'll own Epicor Kinetic implementations end to end, from kickoff through go live and post implementation review, following the Epicor Signature Methodology. You'll run project plans, budgets, risks, and stakeholder communication, and you'll coordinate our consultants, client teams, and Epicor resources to keep engagements on track. You'll also help maintain a consolidated view of engagement health across our portfolio and contribute to how we run our delivery practice internally.

Hands-on experience managing Epicor Kinetic (or E10) implementation projects. This is a hard requirement and it will be verified through references from Epicor ecosystem work
Working knowledge of the Epicor Signature Methodology stages: Prepare, Plan, Design, Validate, Deploy
5 or more years of ERP project management experience with manufacturing or distribution clients
Strong command of project fundamentals: scope, schedule, budget, risk, and change management
Clear, confident communication with executives and plant floor teams alike
PMP or equivalent certification is a plus
Willingness to travel occasionally to client sites

Annual performance bonus tied to team and individual billable utilization
Medical and dental coverage and 401(k) with company match after a 90 day introductory period
Fully remote, with occasional client and company travel
Company provided laptop and required software licenses
Support for maintaining your PM certification and continued Epicor training

Why Quantum

You'll be an early, visible member of a growing Epicor partner where your delivery work directly shapes the practice. No layers, no bureaucracy, direct access to leadership, and clients who count on us. And if you're ever in Southern California, the office is two blocks from the beach.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Closing Date: 7th September 2026 (COB)

Business Introduction

We manufacture and supply reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance.

Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2024 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Our supply chain is not just core to our operations; it’s vital to bringing our innovations to patients as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible. Technology is transforming how we manufacture medicines and vaccines, enabling us to increase the speed, quality and scale of product supply.

We need the very best minds and capability to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients.

Position Summary

You will lead projects that improve how we deliver value for patients and customers. You will work closely with colleagues across functions and locations. We value clear communicators who build trust, make data-informed decisions, and help teams deliver reliable outcomes. This role offers growth, visible impact, and the chance to contribute to GSK’s mission of uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Responsibilities

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

Create and maintain clear project plans that define scope, milestones, resources and risks.
Lead cross-functional teams using matrix management to deliver projects on time and on budget.
Track progress, report status and escalate issues to sponsors and stakeholders as needed.
Identify improvement opportunities across end-to-end processes to simplify customer experience.
Manage vendor relationships and coordinate external suppliers to meet project needs.
Ensure safety, quality and compliance are embedded in all project activities.

Why You?

Basic Qualification

We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:

Degree or equivalent experience in a relevant discipline, or proven project management experience.
Strong experience managing projects in a complex, regulated or technical environment.
Demonstrable stakeholder engagement and communication skills across multiple levels.
Experience producing and maintaining project plans, schedules and status reports.

Preferred Qualification

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

Professional project management qualification (PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent).
Experience with project tools such as Microsoft Project, Power BI or similar.
Background in regulated manufacturing, supply chain or life sciences environments.
Experience with process improvement or operational excellence methods.
Strong financial awareness with experience managing project budgets.
Experience leading product transfers, technical or capital projects.

Working arrangement

This role is onsite at Barnard Castle in the UK. You will be expected to work on site regularly to lead the scheduling team and engage with manufacturing and site stakeholders.

Apply now

If this role feels like the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply. Tell us how your experience matches the responsibilities and qualifications. We look forward to learning about you and how you could help us get ahead of disease together.

Skills

Communication, Cross-Departmental Collaboration, Innovation, Leadership, Presentation Techniques, Project Controls, Project Management, Project Management Governance, Project Planning, Project Tracking, Risk Management, Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Leadership, Timeline Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Cleared
jobs.description:
About Aalyria

Aalyria is a leading technology company that supplies laser communications technology and temporospatial software-defined networking platforms to the aerospace industry. With technology acquired from Google, Aalyria is at the forefront of innovation in satellite and airborne mesh networks, as well as cislunar and deep-space communications. We are revolutionizing the orchestration and management of planetary mesh networks using any radio or optical spectrum, any orbit, and any hardware across land, sea, air, and space.

Role Overview

Aalyria's Spacetime platform orchestrates highly dynamic aerospace networks using a temporospatial Software Defined Networking (SDN) approach, managing not just routing but the physical link topology and lower-layer configuration underneath it.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to own execution on one of our most sensitive customer programs, work that requires an active TS/SCI clearance

, with a polygraph strongly preferred given the access levels involved. You'll be the linchpin between Aalyria's engineering teams and a cleared government customer, driving technical tradeoffs directly rather than simply tracking them. Engineering will look to you to make sequencing, scope, and architecture-adjacent calls, and to represent program status and risk with complete accuracy to customer stakeholders who may not always have full visibility into every technical detail.

This is a role for someone who can operate independently inside a classified environment, hold their own in a room with Staff or Principal engineers, and get things done through influence rather than authority.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Technical Program Execution: Own program planning and execution for a classified Spacetime engineering effort, driving the work through each phase of the mission and directly resolving cross-system dependencies and technical tradeoffs, not just surfacing them for others to decide.
Cleared Customer & Stakeholder Leadership: Serve as the primary programmatic interface with a cleared government customer, communicating fluently with both technical staff and senior government stakeholders across classified and unclassified channels.
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Run the operating rhythm, such as kickoffs, technical reviews, exec readouts, that keeps Engineering, Product, and Solutions Engineering aligned on status, risk, and decisions across compartmented and uncompartmented workstreams.
Requirements Translation & Technical Judgment: Translate customer and mission requirements into actionable engineering plans. You should be able to read and critique a design document unaided, and reason in real time about latency, throughput, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs.
Security & Compliance Stewardship: Handle classified information and CUI correctly as a matter of course, maintain a sound personal security posture, and follow program security and export-control (ITAR/EAR) requirements without needing to be reminded. Partner closely with the FSO and IT/Cybersecurity, who are direct stakeholders in how this role is evaluated.
Contract & Financial Management: Own T&M or cost-type contract reporting requirements, including monthly labor, subcontract, hardware, and materials tracking at the Master Equipment List (MEL) level to support invoicing.
Risk & Delivery Coordination: Identify schedule, scope, and dependency risk early; escalate with context; and coordinate mitigations directly with engineering leads across development, staging, and dedicated government cloud production environments.

Required Qualifications

Active TS/SCI clearance in good standing. TS/SCI with polygraph is strongly preferred given the access levels this role requires.
5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related role delivering complex technical platforms, ideally for U.S. Government or defense/space customers.
Demonstrated technical depth: the ability to read and critique a design document unaided, and to engage engineering teams on architecture, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs as a peer, not a translator.
A track record with genuinely technical programs, infrastructure migrations, API/interface contracts, cross-system dependency resolution, or multi-team technical rollouts, not just cross-functional coordination with a technical flavor.
Proven ability to influence without authority and interface confidently with senior government and customer stakeholders.
Experience managing complex project financials, resource tracking, or strict contractual reporting requirements (T&M, FFP, or cost-type contracts).
U.S. citizenship (required to hold and maintain the clearance level above).
Background in engineering, hardware/software systems, or solutions architecture, or a related field with hands-on experience running technical programs alongside engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with networking, telecom, or SDN/traffic engineering concepts.
Strong background in satellite and mission operations — early-orbit commissioning, fleet readiness, or operating in high-consequence environments.
Experience supporting programs that have transitioned from prototype to production volumes, and improving TRL/MRL along the way.
In-depth knowledge of USG acquisition processes, FAR/DFARS, and contract vehicles (BAAs, sole-source, IDIQs, OTAs).
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field — preferred, not mandatory. Equivalent hands-on technical experience is evaluated on equal footing.
Willingness to travel occasionally as program needs require.

What We Offer

Innovative Environment: Work at a cutting-edge company shaping the future of aerospace communications.
Impactful Work: Directly contribute to critical national security programs and initiatives.
Growth Opportunities: Expand your career with opportunities for professional development and advancement.
Inclusive Culture: Be part of a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive workplace where your contributions matter.
Flexibility: Flexible working arrangements including hybrid remote/in-office schedules.
Compensation and Equity: Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits (401(k), dental, vision, health, life insurance), paid time off, and equity options.

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position involves access to export-controlled information. To comply with U.S. government export regulations, applicants must meet one of the following criteria:

Qualify as a U.S. person, which includes:
U.S. citizen or national
U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder)
Refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157
Asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158
Be eligible to access export-controlled information without requiring an export authorization.
Be eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the necessary export authorization from the appropriate U.S. government agency.

The company reserves the right to decline pursuing an export licensing process for legitimate business-related reasons.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Qualified applicants from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

170,000 - 200,000 USD per year (Remote (United States))

The Program Manager, Owner Experience serves as a subject matter expert in Mazda's Omotenashi philosophy and is responsible for translating strategic priorities into programs and initiatives that strengthen dealer adoption, enhance the owner experience, and support reail excellence across the dealer network. Working independently and in partnership with dealer leadership, field teams, Retail Operations, Training, and cross-functional stakeholders, this role develops, implements, and sustains programs that drive engagement, capability building, recognition, best-practice sharing, and continuous improvement to foster a customer-centric culture and long-term business results.

Major Responsibilities

(60%) Omotenashi Program Management & Enablement
Drive Owner Experience and Omotenashi initiatives from concept through implementation; inclusive of program design, plans, roadmaps, budgets, timelines, milestones, and success metrics
Develop and implement tools, resources, frameworks, and best practices that help dealerships operationalize Mazda’s Omotenashi philosophy and Behavioral Framework
Execute communications strategies and engagement plans that drive awareness, participation, and adoption of Omotenashi initiatives throughout the dealer network
Create dealer-facing communications related to Omotenashi activations, ambassador engagement, workshops, leadership forums, recognition programs, and new initiatives
Deliver dealer recognition initiatives that celebrate achievements, reinforce desired behaviors, and showcase impactful Omotenashi implementation
Design and develop executive presentations, facilitation materials, implementation guides, business cases, dealer resources, communication campaigns, and support materials
Partner with Retail Operations, Regions, Field Teams, CRM, Training, Marketing, HR, and other business functions to embed Omotenashi principles into existing programs, tools, and processes
Support internal MNAO adoption of Omotenashi principles through communications, storytelling, engagement activities, and cross-functional collaboration
Champion Omotenashi through presentations and facilitation for dealer, regional, and internal audiences
Identify program risks, barriers, and opportunities; implement solutions to support successful outcomes

(25%) Dealer Engagement
Drive initiatives that expand, strengthen, and sustain Mazda’s dealer community
Develop engagement strategies for dealership Omotenashi Ambassadors and dealer leadership
Coordinate and facilitate dealer activations, ambassador workshops, leadership Forums, networking opportunities, peer-learning events, and community-building activities
Build strong relationships with dealer leaders, ambassadors, area experience managers, and regional teams to drive participation and long-term engagement
Support dealer onboarding and activation efforts by developing implementation resources, engagement plans, and sustainment strategies
Partner with regional teams to identify opportunities to increase dealer participation and elevate dealer performance
Identify, document, and share dealership best practices that support broader adoption throughout the Mazda network
Capture dealer feedback, challenges, and emerging needs to continuously improve Omotenashi initiatives and engagement strategies

(15%) Metrics Development & Continuous Improvement
Develop measurement strategies evaluating dealer engagement, adoption, effectiveness, and business impact of Omotenashi initiatives
Establish and monitor key performance indicators for Ambassador engagement, dealership participation, community growth, activation progress, communications effectiveness, and recognition efforts
Analyze qualitative and quantitative feedback from dealers, Ambassadors, field teams, and owners to identify trends, opportunities, and barriers to adoption
Develop executive reporting, dashboards, presentations, and strategic recommendations that translate insights into action
Measure the effectiveness of workshops, forums, resources, communications, activation efforts, and dealer engagement activities while identifying opportunities for improvement
Partner with cross-functional teams to connect Omotenashi initiatives to owner experience, customer satisfaction, dealer performance, retention, and loyalty outcomes
Identify emerging trends, innovative approaches, and best practices that strengthen Mazda’s owner experience and retail culture
Perform other duties as assigned
Comply with all policies and standards
The preceding functions have been provided as examples of the types of work performed by employees assigned to this job classification. Management reserves the right to add, modify, change or rescind the work assignments of different positions and to make reasonable accommodations so that qualified employees can perform the essential functions of the job

5+ years experience in customer experience, sales operations, sales enablement, or related fields required
3+ years experience leading cross-functional initiatives and projects from concept through implementation required
Experience in automotive retail, dealership operations, customer experience, culture transformation, community-building, or dealer-facing experience preferred

Bachelor Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) Business Administration/Management Required
Bachelor Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) Business Communications Required

Leadership skills are essential. Must be able to utilize appropriate interpersonal styles and methods in guiding individuals, departments, or groups toward task accomplishment. jobs.description:
Location:
Remote, United States
Industry:
Data Centers | Engineering | Construction | Technology
About the Role

Apex Infrastructure Consultants is seeking a highly organized and analytical Technical Program Manager to support change management across a global portfolio of data centers.
In this role, you will collaborate with data center design, engineering, construction, operations, product development, and other cross-functional teams to track technical changes, manage dependencies, improve workflows, and provide clear program-level reporting.
The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who can manage multiple workstreams, bring structure to complex programs, communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, and transform manual processes into scalable, repeatable systems.

What You’ll Do
Manage and report on multiple, simultaneous technical change-management workstreams.
Partner with data center design, engineering, construction, operations, and product teams.
Track program dependencies, risks, milestones, decisions, and implementation status.
Develop program roadmaps ranging from executive-level plans to detailed task-level views.
Create dashboards, reports, presentations, and notifications for regional and global stakeholders.
Improve data collection, reporting, and workflow processes through automation and standardization.
Partner with Engineering Change Management teams to develop scalable workflows and data frameworks.
Review and improve technical change documentation for accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
Maintain consistent quality standards and execution timelines across managed programs.
Identify delayed workstreams, process gaps, and stakeholder misalignment before they affect delivery.
Lead escalations and drive consensus among stakeholders with different priorities.
Gather feedback and recommend practical process, technology, and change-management improvements.
Identify and apply best practices from other teams, programs, and business units.
Build strong working relationships and move initiatives forward without direct authority.
Coordinate meetings, document decisions, track action items, and support other program activities as needed.
Collaborate remotely with teams across multiple regions and time zones.

Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, architecture, project management, business, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
Five or more years of experience in project management, program management, project coordination, engineering operations, construction, or a related field.
Experience managing multiple workstreams involving cross-functional stakeholders.
Advanced experience using Excel, Google Sheets, or similar tools for data analysis, tracking, and reporting.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing technical documentation, reports, and presentations.
Strong analytical and organizational skills with the ability to identify trends, risks, dependencies, and actionable insights.
Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and move programs forward with limited direction.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with one or more of the following is helpful, but not required:
Data centers, construction, engineering, infrastructure, or technology programs.
Engineering change management, technical change control, or configuration management.
Process improvement, workflow automation, and operational excellence.
Building data structures, reporting systems, or program dashboards.
SQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL, or similar database and query tools.
Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, or another data-visualization platform.
AI-enabled workflow automation or implementation of AI tools for repeatable tasks.
Professional design, engineering, or construction consulting.
PMP, CCM, PE, P.Eng., RA, or a comparable professional certification or license.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role
You can bring structure and clarity to complex, fast-moving programs.
You communicate effectively with technical teams, leadership, and business stakeholders.
You recognize risks and misalignment without waiting to be assigned a task.
You are comfortable managing multiple priorities across teams and time zones.
You can influence decisions and drive consensus without formal authority.
You look for opportunities to simplify, automate, and continuously improve existing processes.
You can translate detailed program data into clear recommendations and executive-level updates.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Development Project Manager
jobs.description:
Remote in Phoenix, AZ

At Gulfstream, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We believe in inspiring and empowering every individual to reach their fullest potential. From workforce development and meaningful connections to a culture of trust, respect, and integrity, we invest in our employees so they can do their best work and achieve success together. Creating and delivering the world's finest aviation experience starts with our people and when our people thrive, so does our mission.

Are you passionate about improving manufacturing performance and building strong supplier partnerships? As a Supply Chain Development Project Manager
, you will serve as a key liaison between Gulfstream and one of our major suppliers in the Phoenix area. You will lead supply chain improvement efforts, solve complex operational challenges, and help ensure suppliers can meet production demands while delivering quality products on time. This is a highly visible role with significant impact across the business and expected regional travel of up to 75%.

What You Will Do

Serve as the primary Gulfstream contact for major supplier(s) in the Phoenix area.
Lead supplier assessments to evaluate production readiness, capacity, and operational performance.
Identify improvement opportunities and drive action plans through completion.
Partner with suppliers to improve delivery performance, quality, lead times, and overall efficiency.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and Six Sigma principles.
Analyze supplier operations, production planning, materials management, capacity planning, and workflow processes.
Support supplier transition plans while minimizing impact to Gulfstream production schedules.
Facilitate daily operational meetings, recovery plans, and milestone reviews with suppliers and internal teams.
Act as a liaison between suppliers and Gulfstream stakeholders to ensure clear communication and issue resolution.
Develop and monitor performance metrics, capacity plans, training plans, and project plans.
Identify root causes of operational challenges and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Coach and mentor suppliers and team members in problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies.
Support the most critical supplier and supply chain challenges across the business.

What You Will Bring

Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Six (6) years of operational and/or supply chain experience.
Strong knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience leading projects and driving measurable business results.
Ability to analyze complex manufacturing and supply chain challenges and develop practical solutions.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills with both internal and external stakeholders.
Experience working directly with suppliers and cross-functional teams.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and related business applications.
Ability to travel extensively, including more than 75% travel as business needs require.
Preferred: Experience in manufacturing environments and manufacturing processes.
Preferred: Lean or Six Sigma certification.
Preferred: Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or related operational experience.

Why Gulfstream

Make a direct impact on supplier performance and production success.
Lead meaningful projects with visibility across the organization.
Work closely with suppliers to solve real-world operational challenges.
Collaborate with talented teams focused on continuous improvement and innovation.
Grow your leadership, project management, and supply chain expertise.
Build a rewarding career supporting the world's finest aviation products.

Apply Now

If you are ready to help strengthen supplier partnerships, drive continuous improvement, and support operational excellence, we encourage you to apply today. Join Gulfstream and help us fulfill our mission to create and deliver the world's finest aviation experience.

Education And Experience Requirements

Bachelor's Degree Business Management, Operations required or equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. 6 years combined Operational and/or Supply Chain experience to include proficiency with LEAN/Six Sigma tools and concepts. Other Lean/Six Sigma certification in area of discipline preferred. Position Purpose
:Assist in the development of standardized tools and with a teamwork approach, evaluate suppliers' business systems and mfg processes and work closely with suppliers through collaborative relationships to improve response time from supply base, reduced risk of multi-tier supply chain disruption, reduce risk of shortages, reduce lead-times, improve quality, increase delivery performance. Provide Operational, Supply Chain, and Logistical support to the Supply Chain and sub-tier suppliers to improve suppliers' operational issues. Lead focused supplier teams through continuous improvement activities. Assigned to most critical supply chain issues. Act as a mentor to Supply Chain Improvement Specialists III.

Job Description

Principle Duties and Responsibilities:Essential Functions:

Lead elements of assessments to determine suppliers ability to meet production rates. Identify and drive closer of improvement opportunities .
Utilize standardized assessment tools, identify opportunities of improvement in the operational areas of maintenance management, production control, materials planning, system analysis, productivity analysis and cost control, production planning, productivity, capacity planning and analysis, managing suppliers, machining and assembly, internal quality control, and other lean manufacturing principles .
Provide oversight and guidance to suppliers and drive actions that address opportunities and validate that the action is implemented and shows marked measured improvement .
Through continuous improvement measure the supply chain by gathering standardized leading indicator metrics that facilitate the ability to proactively address negative trends that may adversely affect delivery performance .
Lead suppliers through transition planning and execution with minimal impact to the companys production line.
Provide on-site support to the Supply Chain, Operations and Logistics .
Act as a liaison between suppliers and internal functional areas to ensure information, documentation and product flow meet objectives.
Work with the suppliers to identify Operational, Supply Chain and Quality constraints while providing value added process improvements to reduce supplier cycle times to meet program deadlines .
Coordinate, chair and lead daily operational meetings and conference calls with suppliers to provide critical milestone plans, recovery actions and information to purchasing when required.
Assist the suppliers in the development of performance metrics, capacity plans, employee training matrices, milestone plans and project plans.
Develop, coach and mentor problem solving skills. Create problem solvers within the organization .
Participate and lead joint continuous improvement events .
Establish methods that identify and/or track root causes and provide corrective action .

Perform other duties as assigned.Other Requirements:

Computer literate, MS Office, various software apps.
Project management skills with working knowledge of the principles of analytical problem solving techniques.
Mfg and Industrial eng experience preferred.

A credit history check from a national credit bureau will be conducted for all candidates for this position including new hires and current employees seeking promotion or transfer. This job requires one to be able to read, write, speak, and understand the English language.

Job Description

Voor onze Animal Health locatie in Boxmeer zoeken wij een Programma Manager

Binnen onze Animal Health-organisatie in Boxmeer is de afdeling Capital Investments verantwoordelijk voor het beheer en de uitvoering van investeringsprojecten. Onder deze afdeling valt het team Site Engineering, dat technische projecten realiseert op het gebied van nieuwbouw, renovatie en verbouwing op de locaties Boxmeer en De Bilt. Dit omvat onder meer bouwkundige, proces technische en installatieprojecten, evenals verpakkingsconcepten. Het team levert hiervoor projectmanagement- en projectengineering-support.

In deze rol ben je de single point of contact voor een aan jou toegewezen interne klant (Productie-Unit of Center of Excellence). In deze rol werk je nauw samen met een grote diversiteit aan interne (e.g. Asset Management, Facilities, Environment, Health & Safety, Manufacturing (EHS)) en externe stakeholders (leveranciers, contractors) en rapporteer je aan de Manager Site Engineering.

Verantwoordelijk voor het aansturen van de projectleiders die binnen zijn projectportfolio werken;
Regelt en coördineert in nauw overleg met de Planner en Resource Manager de bezetting van de projectteams binnen zijn project-portfolio;

Is eindverantwoordelijk voor de veiligheid op de projectlocaties binnen zijn projectportfolio;
Treedt binnen de afd. SE op als kennisdrager van één of meerdere specialismen (denk aan standaarden of een technisch specialisme);
Is eindverantwoordelijk voor project scoping, haalbaarheidsstudies, concept- en basic engineering, budget-raming, planning en investeringsaanvragen t.b.v. projecten in zijn projectportfolio;
Is de interface tussen de klant, Site Engineering-projectteam en alle overige in het project benodigde stake-holders van de site;
Overlegt samen met de manager van Site Engineering en andere Lead-Engineers de personele, organisatorische en functionele zaken en stemt deze af op de behoefte van de site.

Een afgeronde opleiding op Academisch/HBO niveau in een relevante technische richting;
Ruime en succesvolle ervaring met het initiëren, managen en opleveren van technische (capex) projecten in een relevante productieomgeving (pharma, biotech, kleine chemie, food);
Zeer sterk ontwikkelde project- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden, je weet op handige wijze verbinding te maken op verschillende niveaus;
VCA I en II gecertificeerd, kennis van EHS-regelgeving en bekend met Lean Six Sigma principes;
Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels;
Woonachtig op een redelijke afstand van Boxmeer (deze rol vraagt om minimaal 4 dagen per week aanwezigheid).

About Unison:

Unison’s products power the business of government to work smoother and smarter, making critical federal processes and acquisitions simpler and more effective. Trusted by over 200,000 federal employees and government contractors, our AI-infused software and deep domain expertise help contract shops, cost engineers, 1102s, program managers, and budgeting professionals cut through friction, keep compliance airtight, and sharpen decisions. Our federal focus brings efficiency, transparency, and clarity to complex data, regulations, and workflows, empowering agencies and executives to spend more minutes on mission and achieve strategic objectives. Unison is how federal business gets done.

Unison
is proud to be recognized as a 2026 Quantum Certified Workplace™ in Washington D.C., reflecting our continued focus on building a workplace where people feel supported and teams thrive.

Unison, a leading provider of procurement and program management solutions to the federal marketplace, is seeking a Senior Program Manager to be a leader for delivery and operations and maintenance of large-scale, complex federal programs, including enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems. This is a senior consulting leadership role for an experienced professional services PM who has run highly complex federal delivery from proposal through steady-state operations.

Unison consultants work directly with clients to understand business objectives, improve acquisition and grants management processes, and successfully implement and operate Unison's suite of software products. Our Senior Program Managers are trusted senior leaders who own delivery outcomes, manage client and executive relationships, and build the teams and processes that make complex federal engagements succeed.

Responsibilities:

Unison is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead delivery and operations of enterprise-scale federal technology programs, including but not limited to ERP, acquisition, and grants management implementations and operations. This role will serve as a senior delivery lead across one or more Federal client engagements, owning program health, client relationships, and financial performance throughout the full program lifecycle; from modernization implementations and operations & maintenance (O&M).
Own end-to-end delivery for large, complex federal programs, serving as the senior point of accountability for scope, schedule, budget, and quality

Drive continuous improvement of PMO standards, tools, and delivery best practices across the portfolio
Identify and develop staffing pipeline and succession plans for key delivery roles within assigned programs
Represent Unison as a senior leader with clients, partners, and industry stakeholders

Required Experience

Extensive experience as a Project/Program Manager, including significant experience delivering integrated federal ERP business systems, or large-scale enterprise technology programs (e.g., PRISM, Momentum, PeopleSoft Federal, Oracle Federal Financials, SAP, Workday Federal)
Experience as a Program/Project Manager within a professional services or government consulting firm, including direct ownership of client relationships, statements of work, scope management, and staffing/utilization

Experience owning program budgets, margin performance, and financial reporting for delivery engagements
Experience managing executive-level client relationships and facilitating governance, briefings, and escalations
Experience building, leading, and mentoring cross-functional delivery teams across the full program lifecycle
Experience leading delivery in Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid environments
Experience supporting proposal development, capture, and pricing for federal contract vehicles
Experience managing subcontractors or teaming partners on federal programs

Preferred Experience

Federal acquisition and procurement lifecycle concepts
Experience with a Department level Federal Agency.

Core Skills & Abilities

Exceptional executive presence and client-facing leadership skills
Proven ability to own program-level financial and delivery outcomes
Strong ability to influence and align technical, functional, and executive stakeholders
Sound judgment under pressure, with strong risk identification and mitigation skills
Ability to manage multiple complex programs and competing priorities simultaneously
Strong mentorship and team-building capabilities
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities

Education & Certifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) is a plus

jobs.description:
The San Francisco Museum of Modern Art is one of the largest museums of modern and contemporary art in the United States and a thriving cultural center for the Bay Area. We cannot imagine life without art; it inspires and connects us every day. Now more than ever, these connections matter and are aligned with our values
.

Inclusive
: We strive to be a museum of many voices in dialogue.

Passionate
: We believe working with art is more than a job or trusteeship - it's a way of life.

Brave
: We are committed to approaching our work with courage and a sense of adventure, always ready to explore new perspectives.

Empathic
: We aim to act like a person, not an institution.

SFMOMA is a place for the infinitely curious to explore, support, and experience the art of our time. We believe that modern and contemporary art can influence the way we think, view the world, and embrace the many voices and perspectives around us. We aspire to foster an environment that elicits joy, nurtures a sense of belonging and purpose—where difference is seen as a strength, and every one is appreciated for their whole self.

Schedule
: Full Time, 35/hours per week, at least three days working onsite, occasional evenings and weekends required

The Program Manager, Audience Development & Engagement leads the strategy, development, and execution of programs designed to drive cultural relevance, engage diverse audiences, and deliver measurable audience growth.

This high-impact role creates broad-audience experiences that simultaneously generate revenue, enhance brand equity, and cultivate the next generation of SFMOMA visitors, with particular attention to audiences who may not see themselves as traditional museumgoers. The Program Manager seeks out unexpected partnerships, formats, and moments that help new audiences feel SFMOMA's relevance, while also finding ways to deepen the museum's relationship with frequent visitors and members. T his role thinks in terms of the full visitor lifecycle — from first awareness to repeat, loyal engagement — and builds programs that move audiences along that path over time.

The projects can range from managing existing events and programs such as Rooftop Radio , organizing dynamic partner events and pop-ups, to audience surveying and research that builds a deeper understanding of who SFMOMA's audiences are, how they move from curiosity to commitment, and what sustains their long-term connection to the museum. This audience insight directly informs program design and iteration — the role is expected to pilot new ideas , test unconventional channels and partners, and resist formulaic programming in favor of approaches tailored to how different audience segments engage .

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this position collaborates closely across departments to ensure all programming is exhibition-aligned, brand-coherent, and seamlessly integrated with museum operations — while keeping an eye on measurable outcomes across the full arc of the visitor relationship, not just single-event attendance.

Responsibilities & Duties

Experiential Programming Strategy & Execution: Own the end-to-end strategy, development, and execution of public-facing experiential programming designed to introduce SFMOMA to new audiences in unexpected contexts both inside and outside the museum , including piloting new formats and partnerships to test what resonates with different audience segments.
Audience Insight & Segmentation: Lead audience surveying and research to build ongoing understanding of visitor segments, motivations, and behavior across the lifecycle — from first-time visitors to repeat and loyal audiences — and use these insights to inform program design, targeting, and iteration.
Influencer & Creator Partnerships: In partnership with the Social Media Team, l ead influencer and creator activations to drive cultural relevance and maximize earned media reach for selec t exhibitions, events, and programs.
Event Support:
Design member experience events in coordination with the Membership t eam to deepen loyalty and create aspirational access moments.
Execute press previews and media-facing activations in close partnership with the Communications team.
Partner with Public Events to deliver social programming (such as late-night member and public events that center experiences over curriculum).

Tourism & Convention Initiatives: Collaborate and support tourism-related experiences and events, including participation at annual conventions.
Cross-Functional Workflow & Operations: Collaborate regularly with department leadership (Marketing, Communications, Visitor Experience, and Operations ) to align priorities and ensure seamless cross-departmental execution.
Strategic Measurement & Problem Solving: Drive strategic initiatives by implementing measurement systems, compiling audience and program data to solve complex operational problems, and preparing comprehensive impact reports that track progress across the visitor lifecycle.
Maintain positive, collaborative relationships with people across the organization to ensure success of cross-functional initiatives

Qualifications & Skills

Minimum of six (6) years of experience in experiential marketing, cultural programming, brand partnerships, or public-facing live events within museums, live entertainment, hospitality, or creative agencies.
Experience with audience research methods (surveys, focus groups, or visitor data analysis) and using insights to shape program strategy and targeting.
R obust project management background, with a proven ability to manage multiple complex activations and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
P osition requires a high level of independence, discretion, and responsibility regarding high-visibility public matters and strategic partnerships.
Highly organized, proactive, and capable of anticipating needs, establishing workflows for undefined processes, and navigating changing priorities with tight deadlines.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; capable of building positive, collaborative relationships across internal management, staff, trustees, donors, external creators, and media partners.
Excellent computer skills, including strong proficiency in standard office suites and producing impactful presentations.

jobs.title: Product Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Lume And Mando

Founded in 2017, Lume is a transformative personal care brand on a mission to normalize body odor beyond pits and provide people with outrageously effective solutions so they don’t have to think twice about odor. We are pioneers of the whole body deodorant category, with a portfolio of odor-blocking products including anti-perspirants, aluminum-free deodorants, body washes, body creams, cleansing bars and laundry sprays. Lume products are OB/GYN developed, made with skin-safe ingredients that are gentle enough for the most sensitive parts and often referred to as “life-changing” by our customers. In late 2022, we launched a men’s line called Mando, bringing our expertise to the men’s personal care category. From whole body deodorants to body washes, our product offerings arm men with the confidence to show up as their best selves as they move about their busy day.

Lume and Mando are part of Mammoth Brands, the modern CPG company behind category-leading brands Harry’s, Flamingo, Lume, Mando, and Coterie. Driven by a mission to “Create Things People Like More,” the company is creating a new model—and home—for brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples’ lives and ultimately change the status quo. Even as we grow, we take extra care to maintain the small, scrappy, entrepreneurial culture that helped to get us where we are today: a company that people like more, that better serves its customers, employees, and community. Mammoth Brands is committed to making a positive impact and donated over $20 million through our network of nonprofit partners to date.

We build brands that move fast and think big — and we hire people who are curious about AI, willing to experiment with it in their day-to-day work, and excited to accelerate what's possible. We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it.

About The Team

The Global Product Team is responsible for all aspects of product development and design from ideation through production. The team leads the company’s largest product initiatives through the creation, development, and testing of innovative, high-quality goods that will be sold to and experienced by customers all over the world.

Within the Product Team, the Program Management team is responsible for overall program scoping, driving cross-functional teams to define and execute development and design strategy, and ensuring all workstreams ladder up successfully to launch new products.

About The Role

We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented leader who thrives in ambiguity and loves making things happen. This is an ideal role for someone eager to own big outcomes and grow within a fast-moving product organization.

As a Product Program Manager, you’ll lead cross-functional workstreams and teams at all levels through thoughtful planning, execution, and support from concept through product launch. You’ll manage a high volume of commercial initiatives and bundles. Success in this role means being a doer who brings structure, builds relationships, and drives momentum across functions.

What You Will Do

Drive execution across a high volume of product programs, primarily commercial and bundle initiatives, from scoping through launch
Lead cross-functional teams through development planning, timelines, and risk mitigation to ensure deliverables align with business goals
Collaborate across product development, marketing, sourcing, operations, quality, finance, design, and sales to move work forward quickly and efficiently
Work with domestic and international suppliers and manufacturers throughout development
Clearly communicate updates, blockers, and decisions to stakeholders, including senior leadership, tailoring messages to different audiences
Identify and implement workflow, tool, or process improvements that enable faster, more efficient execution

This Should Describe You

Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years experience in roles that require ownership, coordination, and execution. This can include rotational programs, operations, finance, or product development. Industry experience in CPG, startups, or fast-paced environments a plus but not required
No technical background required. We care more about your ownership, drive, and ability to get teams aligned and moving
You are a self-starter with strong judgment and a proven track record of accountability. You don’t wait to be told what to do, and you’re energized by figuring things out
You bring structure to chaos by breaking down complexity, asking the right questions, and keeping others focused on what matters
You communicate clearly and confidently across stakeholders, internal and external, senior and peer-level
You identify problems, own solutions, and take pride in driving outcomes rather than simply completing tasks
You build trust quickly across teams, balancing input from multiple stakeholders while staying focused on the goal
You are curious, adaptable, and resilient in the face of ambiguity, shifting priorities, or unexpected challenges
You bring a positive outlook and a sense of humor. We take our work seriously and ourselves less so

Here's Who You'll Work With

Working on the Product Program Management team, which is part of the Global Product team
Working closely with Product Development, Package Development, Marketing, Global Supply, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Sales, and Design teams as well as external supplier/vendor partners

Benefits And Perks

Medical, dental, and vision coverage
401k match
Equity in Mammoth Brands
Flexible time off and working hours
L&D stipend
4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years, 6 weeks after 10 years, and 8 weeks after 15 years
20 fully paid weeks off for parents who give birth, or 16 fully paid weeks off for all other paths to parenthood
Fun IRL and virtual events including happy hours, team building events, and parties on our rooftop
Free products from our family of brands

The Mammoth Brands' working model is in-office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Job Description Summary

Job Description Summary

Under the guidance of the Director of Emergency Management, the Business Continuity Program Manager will support the development, implementation, management, and sustainment of the University of Kansas Medical Center's comprehensive Business Continuity Program, advancing organizational resilience and operational preparedness. The Program Manager will collaborate with academic, research, clinical, and administrative stakeholders to identify critical business functions, assess operational risks and vulnerabilities, and develop strategies that ensure continuity of operations during disruptions, emergencies, disasters, and technology outages.

Key responsibilities include leading and facilitating Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), conducting risk assessments, developing and maintaining Business Continuity Plans (BCPs), and coordinating the creation of departmental and enterprise downtime playbooks to support continued operations during system interruptions and other adverse events. The Business Continuity Program Manager will establish program standards, methodologies, and performance measures; support training, exercises, and plan validation activities; and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance organizational readiness and recovery capabilities.

The Program Manager will serve as a key partner in strengthening the institution's capacity to anticipate, withstand, respond to, and recover from disruptions while maintaining its mission of patient care, education, research, and service.

Job Description

Program Framework & Standards

Establishes a framework and methodology to manage all business continuity lifecycle activities including risk assessment, business impact analysis, strategy development, implementation, testing and review, plan maintenance and updates.

Business Continuity Planning & Risk Assessment

Work with internal business units to understand their specific business continuity and contingency needs.

Technology & IT Coordination

Collaborate closely with Information Technology to ensure the IT Disaster Recovery (DR) and Cybersecurity plans are integrated into the overall BC program.

Training, Testing & Continuous Improvement

Develop and execute regular business continuity training, exercises, and required testing. Update plans regularly based on lessons learned.

Platform Administration

Serve as the primary administrator for the Riskonnect Business Continuity platform, overseeing system configuration, user access, data quality, reporting, and ongoing maintenance to support enterprise business continuity, resilience, and operational risk management objectives.

Emergency Response & Monitoring

Monitor the environment for potential threats to the organization and communicate with necessary stakeholders, provide support and expertise during emergency response and recovery initiatives.
Respond during emergency situations and incident management team activations.

Co-chair the BC/DR Committee.

Must participate in an on-call rotation for emergency situations.

jobs.description:
Réalta Technologies is seeking an experienced IT/OT Systems Project Manager to join the global delivery team of one of our large pharmaceutical clients. This role sits at the intersection of IT and OT, managing the planning, governance and delivery of system deployments across the client's global manufacturing network.

The primary focus of this engagement is the delivery of data integration projects connecting Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) with shopfloor systems (e.g. automation, SCADA, PLC and historian layers), enabling reliable, validated data flow between the plant floor and enterprise systems. You will work as part of a global team, coordinating across sites, functions and time zones, and will need to flex between agile and waterfall ways of working depending on project phase and governance requirements.

This is a remote role that will require the successful candidate to work either US EST or EU hours.

Job Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end project management for IT/OT system deployments across multiple global manufacturing sites, from initiation through to hypercare and closure.
Own delivery of data integration projects between MES and shopfloor/automation systems, ensuring scope, schedule, budget and quality targets are met.
Apply the appropriate delivery methodology (Agile or Waterfall) based on project type, regulatory requirements and stakeholder needs, and manage hybrid approaches where required.
Ensure all project activity aligns with GAMP 5 principles and the client's Software/System Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including appropriate validation, documentation and change control.
Manage project plans, RAID logs, resourcing and budgets, and track delivery using Jira (and complementary tools such as Confluence or MS Project).
Coordinate cross-functional and cross-site teams, including IT, OT/automation engineering, QA, validation, and third-party vendors/system integrators.
Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships across global manufacturing, quality, engineering and IT functions, managing expectations and escalations proactively.
Provide clear, regular reporting on project status, risks and issues to steering committees, sponsors and the wider programme team.
Identify and manage project risks, dependencies and interfaces with other workstreams within the wider global programme.
Support change management and end-user adoption activities to ensure smooth transition into operational use.

Job Requirements

Proven experience as a Project Manager delivering IT and/or OT systems projects, ideally within a pharmaceutical, life sciences or other regulated manufacturing environment.
Demonstrable experience managing projects using both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, with the judgement to select and adapt the right approach for the context.
Hands-on experience with Jira for project and delivery tracking.
Solid understanding of GAMP5 and SDLC frameworks, including validation and change control practices within a regulated environment.
Experience managing global, multi-site projects with distributed stakeholders and virtual teams.
Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders across IT, OT, quality and manufacturing functions at all levels.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing and presenting status reports to senior stakeholders and steering committees.
Comfortable working remotely and independently as part of a distributed, global delivery team.

Desirable Skills

Experience with data historian platforms (e.g. AVEVA/Wonderware Historian, PI System) and their integration with MES and enterprise systems.
Direct experience with MES platforms (e.g. POMSnet, PAS-X, Camstar, DeltaV MES or similar) in a pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing context.
Familiarity with shopfloor/automation systems and protocols (SCADA, PLC, batch systems) and how they interface with MES and IT layers.
Recognised project management certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, Scrum Master).
Experience working within or alongside a consulting/systems integration environment.

jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.

THE ROLE:

We are seeking an experienced program manager to own and drive end-to-end AI cluster delivery across the full lifecycle—from solution architecture and planning through NPI validation, internal and external deployments, customer support readiness, and lab capacity execution. This role requires strong analytical, problem-solving, risk management, and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to operate effectively in complex hardware, firmware, software, networking, and datacenter-scale environments.

THE PERSON:

As a Principal Program Manager, you will partner with architecture, engineering, validation, deployment, customer-facing, and lab operations teams to deliver complex AI cluster solutions from concept through production readiness. You will help define customer and platform requirements, establish integrated execution plans, align internal and external stakeholders, and ensure AMD product solution deliverables support successful cluster bring-up, validation, deployment, and customer lifecycle needs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Defines, plans, and drives end-to-end AI cluster delivery programs spanning solution architecture, platform readiness, validation, deployment, customer support, and lifecycle execution.
Possesses a thorough knowledge of program management principles and applies them effectively across small to large-scale cluster delivery initiatives involving multiple technical domains and stakeholder groups.
Has responsibility for programs and processes of significant technical and business importance, including execution results that cross architecture, engineering, NPI validation, lab operations, deployment, and customer support areas.
Initiates and drives improvements to execution models, triage workflows, deployment readiness processes, lab capacity planning, and cross-team operating rhythms to improve delivery efficiency and predictability.
Creates and maintains program artifacts such as integrated schedules, resource and lab capacity plans, deployment plans, validation readiness trackers, risk and issue logs, decision registers, and executive status summaries.
Provides clear program status, dependency mapping, and executive-level visibility across cluster architecture, NPI validation, internal deployments, external/customer deployments, and support readiness.
Identifies actions, owners, and mitigation plans for technical, schedule, capacity, deployment, and customer-impacting risks throughout the cluster delivery lifecycle.
Collaborates with architecture, engineering, validation, deployment, business unit, customer engineering, and lab operations teams to identify areas requiring escalation, corrective action, or executive alignment.
Collects, analyzes, organizes, and publishes program performance data through dashboards, recurring status reports, readiness reviews, and deployment health indicators.
