About Lume And Mando

Founded in 2017, Lume is a transformative personal care brand on a mission to normalize body odor beyond pits and provide people with outrageously effective solutions so they don’t have to think twice about odor. We are pioneers of the whole body deodorant category, with a portfolio of odor-blocking products including anti-perspirants, aluminum-free deodorants, body washes, body creams, cleansing bars and laundry sprays. Lume products are OB/GYN developed, made with skin-safe ingredients that are gentle enough for the most sensitive parts and often referred to as “life-changing” by our customers. In late 2022, we launched a men’s line called Mando, bringing our expertise to the men’s personal care category. From whole body deodorants to body washes, our product offerings arm men with the confidence to show up as their best selves as they move about their busy day.

Lume and Mando are part of Mammoth Brands, the modern CPG company behind category-leading brands Harry’s, Flamingo, Lume, Mando, and Coterie. Driven by a mission to “Create Things People Like More,” the company is creating a new model—and home—for brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples’ lives and ultimately change the status quo. Even as we grow, we take extra care to maintain the small, scrappy, entrepreneurial culture that helped to get us where we are today: a company that people like more, that better serves its customers, employees, and community. Mammoth Brands is committed to making a positive impact and donated over $20 million through our network of nonprofit partners to date.

We build brands that move fast and think big — and we hire people who are curious about AI, willing to experiment with it in their day-to-day work, and excited to accelerate what's possible. We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it.

About The Team

The Global Product Team is responsible for all aspects of product development and design from ideation through production. The team leads the company’s largest product initiatives through the creation, development, and testing of innovative, high-quality goods that will be sold to and experienced by customers all over the world.

Within the Product Team, the Program Management team is responsible for overall program scoping, driving cross-functional teams to define and execute development and design strategy, and ensuring all workstreams ladder up successfully to launch new products.

About The Role

We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented leader who thrives in ambiguity and loves making things happen. This is an ideal role for someone eager to own big outcomes and grow within a fast-moving product organization.

As a Product Program Manager, you’ll lead cross-functional workstreams and teams at all levels through thoughtful planning, execution, and support from concept through product launch. You’ll manage a high volume of commercial initiatives and bundles. Success in this role means being a doer who brings structure, builds relationships, and drives momentum across functions.

What You Will Do

Drive execution across a high volume of product programs, primarily commercial and bundle initiatives, from scoping through launch
Lead cross-functional teams through development planning, timelines, and risk mitigation to ensure deliverables align with business goals
Collaborate across product development, marketing, sourcing, operations, quality, finance, design, and sales to move work forward quickly and efficiently
Work with domestic and international suppliers and manufacturers throughout development
Clearly communicate updates, blockers, and decisions to stakeholders, including senior leadership, tailoring messages to different audiences
Identify and implement workflow, tool, or process improvements that enable faster, more efficient execution

This Should Describe You

Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years experience in roles that require ownership, coordination, and execution. This can include rotational programs, operations, finance, or product development. Industry experience in CPG, startups, or fast-paced environments a plus but not required
No technical background required. We care more about your ownership, drive, and ability to get teams aligned and moving
You are a self-starter with strong judgment and a proven track record of accountability. You don’t wait to be told what to do, and you’re energized by figuring things out
You bring structure to chaos by breaking down complexity, asking the right questions, and keeping others focused on what matters
You communicate clearly and confidently across stakeholders, internal and external, senior and peer-level
You identify problems, own solutions, and take pride in driving outcomes rather than simply completing tasks
You build trust quickly across teams, balancing input from multiple stakeholders while staying focused on the goal
You are curious, adaptable, and resilient in the face of ambiguity, shifting priorities, or unexpected challenges
You bring a positive outlook and a sense of humor. We take our work seriously and ourselves less so

Here's Who You'll Work With

Working on the Product Program Management team, which is part of the Global Product team
Working closely with Product Development, Package Development, Marketing, Global Supply, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Sales, and Design teams as well as external supplier/vendor partners

Benefits And Perks

Equity in Mammoth Brands
Flexible time off and working hours
L&D stipend
4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years, 6 weeks after 10 years, and 8 weeks after 15 years
20 fully paid weeks off for parents who give birth, or 16 fully paid weeks off for all other paths to parenthood
Fun IRL and virtual events including happy hours, team building events, and parties on our rooftop
Free products from our family of brands

The Mammoth Brands' working model is in-office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Our beautiful 70,000 square foot SoHo office is decked out with bagels on Wednesdays and lunch on Thursdays, and fully stocked kitchens with snacks, coffee, and drinks everyday. Can’t forget the free products and the opportunity to have some meetings without Zoom!

We can’t quantify all of the intangible things we think you’ll love about working at Mammoth Brands, like the exciting challenges we tackle, the smart and humble team you’ll get to work with, and our supportive and inclusive culture. Job Description Summary

Under the guidance of the Director of Emergency Management, the Business Continuity Program Manager will support the development, implementation, management, and sustainment of the University of Kansas Medical Center's comprehensive Business Continuity Program, advancing organizational resilience and operational preparedness. The Program Manager will collaborate with academic, research, clinical, and administrative stakeholders to identify critical business functions, assess operational risks and vulnerabilities, and develop strategies that ensure continuity of operations during disruptions, emergencies, disasters, and technology outages.

Key responsibilities include leading and facilitating Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), conducting risk assessments, developing and maintaining Business Continuity Plans (BCPs), and coordinating the creation of departmental and enterprise downtime playbooks to support continued operations during system interruptions and other adverse events. The Business Continuity Program Manager will establish program standards, methodologies, and performance measures; support training, exercises, and plan validation activities; and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance organizational readiness and recovery capabilities.

The Program Manager will serve as a key partner in strengthening the institution's capacity to anticipate, withstand, respond to, and recover from disruptions while maintaining its mission of patient care, education, research, and service.

ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.

THE ROLE:

We are seeking an experienced program manager to own and drive end-to-end AI cluster delivery across the full lifecycle—from solution architecture and planning through NPI validation, internal and external deployments, customer support readiness, and lab capacity execution. This role requires strong analytical, problem-solving, risk management, and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to operate effectively in complex hardware, firmware, software, networking, and datacenter-scale environments.

THE PERSON:

As a Principal Program Manager, you will partner with architecture, engineering, validation, deployment, customer-facing, and lab operations teams to deliver complex AI cluster solutions from concept through production readiness. You will help define customer and platform requirements, establish integrated execution plans, align internal and external stakeholders, and ensure AMD product solution deliverables support successful cluster bring-up, validation, deployment, and customer lifecycle needs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Defines, plans, and drives end-to-end AI cluster delivery programs spanning solution architecture, platform readiness, validation, deployment, customer support, and lifecycle execution.
Possesses a thorough knowledge of program management principles and applies them effectively across small to large-scale cluster delivery initiatives involving multiple technical domains and stakeholder groups.
Has responsibility for programs and processes of significant technical and business importance, including execution results that cross architecture, engineering, NPI validation, lab operations, deployment, and customer support areas.
Initiates and drives improvements to execution models, triage workflows, deployment readiness processes, lab capacity planning, and cross-team operating rhythms to improve delivery efficiency and predictability.
Creates and maintains program artifacts such as integrated schedules, resource and lab capacity plans, deployment plans, validation readiness trackers, risk and issue logs, decision registers, and executive status summaries.
Provides clear program status, dependency mapping, and executive-level visibility across cluster architecture, NPI validation, internal deployments, external/customer deployments, and support readiness.

Collaborates with architecture, engineering, validation, deployment, business unit, customer engineering, and lab operations teams to identify areas requiring escalation, corrective action, or executive alignment.
Collects, analyzes, organizes, and publishes program performance data through dashboards, recurring status reports, readiness reviews, and deployment health indicators.

Job Title:
Senior Technical Program Manager

Job Type:
Full-time

Job Location:
Boston, MA

Reports to:
Vice President of Quantum Computing Services

Summary

QuEra is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead program management activities around product and service delivery of QuEra's quantum computers, starting with Aquila and Gemini, and extending to future generations of QuEra systems.

This role is execution-oriented and inherently cross-functional, coordinating work across hardware and software engineering, research and operations. The role includes limited product management responsibilities, scoped to requirements collection and feedback, and is expected to work collaboratively with future dedicated product management hires.

This role is designed to fulfill these goals, and to evolve as the company grows and the needs change:

Ensure reliable delivery and operation of gate-based quantum computers,
Establish a structured feedback loop from customers and users back into engineering, and align customer projects for success,
Support the product development work on QuEra's systems towards industrial-grade, TRL=9 platforms, through disciplined program execution,
Enable progress tracking and transparent communication across all stakeholders.

Year 1 focus

The main focus in year 1 will be to support the success of QuEra's overall AIST program which consists of 4 threads centered around our first gate-based system Gemini:

[Product] Launching two product lines on top of the on-prem Gemini machine at AIST: Gemini-QEC, a platform for error correction researchers, and Gemini-NISQ, a platform for NISQ-era application developers. Initial product launches will be followed by planned upgrades and feature releases in quick succession.
[Customers & Projects] Enabling the success of concrete customers and customer projects on the Gemini machine at AIST, which divide into preview projects (leading up to each product/feature release and leveraging close collaboration with the machine team), and GA projects (following each product/feature release and utilizing the generally available capabilities). Customer success in this context will depend on a fine balance of customer experience, data quality, and timely execution of project phases.
[Integration] Completing system integration with access/distribution partners, in two modalities: HPC integration, and cloud integration.
[Development] Achieving milestones in the NEDO program focused on developing the hardware and software systems towards industrial-grade quantum computers by 2030. This development work is not independent of, but rather on the critical path for 1-3.

Key responsibilities

Product:
Translate high-level product goals and technical roadmap into executable plans, milestones, and dependencies.
Track risks, schedules, and cross-team deliverables to ensure on-time, high-quality product launches.
Customers and Projects
Act as the program coordination point for customer co-design and onboarding efforts.
Ensure customer expectations, constraints, and feedback are clearly communicated and tracked.
Support technical teams by managing structure, timelines, and communication.
Integration
Act as the program coordination point for integration activities, including alignment efforts and end-to-end tests.
Collect and synthesize requirements from integration partners and stakeholders, spanning functional and non-functional requirements (e.g. API payload vs API security).
Development
Align timelines, requirements and dependencies, with awareness of product, business and operational constraints.
Track progress and support documentation efforts.
Support reporting efforts for external stakeholders (e.g. NEDO program management).
Contribute to QuEra's readiness for scaling gate-based quantum computing beyond Gemini, including operational and organizational considerations.

To achieve a balanced success in 1-4 above, the role will take responsibility for managing machine time across activities, machine use agreements, and regulatory requirements (e.g. data privacy, network security, etc.).

Qualification & Profile

Required:

Engineering background (e.g., semiconductor, systems engineering, advanced computing infrastructure).
Experience in technical program management, system delivery, or execution of complex technical products.
Strong ability to coordinate across multiple teams and external stakeholders.

This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurial, surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to lead company-wide technically complex programs with high impact and urgency.
Do you see building Tech Strategy & Execution (TSE) used company wide as a crucial enabling technology in today's business environment? Do you have strong subject matter expertise in software design architecture and analysis? Do you have a strong background on system design and the data analysis required for defining must have capabilities for a Platform? Do you enjoy solving technically complex problems and deliver outcomes in the realms of AI/ML, cloud computing? Develop new tools and process to support the strategic direction of the organization.

new_jobs.title: Principal, Tech Project Manager - Cybersecurity Delivery Lead
new_jobs.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

Role Description

Northern Trust is seeking a Cybersecurity Delivery Lead
to drive the successful execution of strategic cybersecurity initiatives across key control areas including Privileged Access Management, Identity Governance and Administration, Identity Authentication and Authorisation, Security Operations and Data Protection. This is a high-impact delivery role responsible for leading complex, visible and mission-critical cybersecurity projects across global technology and business teams. The successful candidate will bring strong project delivery discipline, cybersecurity awareness, stakeholder management capability, financial governance experience and the ability to drive outcomes in a highly matrixed financial services environment.

Major Duties

Project Delivery

Lead global teams consisting of technical and non-technical employees and consultants to drive successful execution of strategic cybersecurity projects and programs.
Partner with key business and technology stakeholders to define expected project benefits and outcomes and ensure successful achievement through project completion.
Identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies to ensure successful project completion.
Develop project schedules including effort estimates and task sequences and assignments and ensure they are adhered to; ensure projects are optimally sequenced and coordinated for efficiency.
Lead resolution of conflicts or escalations in support of project or program delivery.
Create and submit project/program status reports that are accurate and comply with team guidelines.
Establish and maintain project artifact repository; review project deliverables to ensure quality and ensure project adheres to internal software delivery methodology.

Communication And Stakeholder Management

Develop project charters; develop and execute project communication plans.
Facilitate engagement with cross-impacted technology and business stakeholders.
Identify and execute approaches to resolve complex problems through critical thinking

Change/Risk Management

Define and document project scope and ensure scope alignment to project objectives and goals.
Perform and follow project change control procedures for scope, resources, and financials where required.
Ensure adherence to technology Change Management requirements and procedures or system implementations.

Financial Management

Oversee financial management and performance for projects including:
developing and/or managing project-specific capital and expense budgets including all financial form submissions required by internal finance teams
preparing and submitting timely monthly forecasts (i.e., Clarity PPM)
proactively analyzing and managing monthly budget variance
optimizing spend for assigned projects
participation in annual budget planning

Staff Management

Identify project resource needs and work with leadership to ensure staffing requirements are met.
Manage project resources to deliver tasks, optimize resource utilization and resolve conflicts.
Provide constructive performance feedback regarding staff performance to leadership and line managers.
Foster a supportive project delivery environment that encourages participation, teamwork, and collaboration.

Methodology and Process Evolution

Identify process improvement opportunities supporting current and evolving program governance standards.
Integrate new tools and technology to support greater efficiency and quality in program planning and delivery.
Evangelize best practices for program delivery and governance adherence with peers, stakeholders, and sponsors.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience Required

A successful candidate for the role will have at least 10 years of overall experience including in Financial Services industry, with at least 5 years’ experience leading and managing high-visibility technology projects. Additionally, the candidate will possess:

Cybersecurity Project Management Experience – leading and driving execution of cybersecurity projects related to Identity & Access Management (i.e., Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Identity Authentication and Authorization (IAA)), Data Protection, Security Operations, or Attack Surface Management.
Organizational Savvy – experience working within a matrixed organization to drive delivery of complex projects involving multiple disciplines.
Problem Solving Skills – ability to handle ambiguous or complex issues including ability to identify creative resolution paths and gaining necessary alignment and support from leadership and stakeholders to bring to resolution.
Superior Communication Skills– ability to articulate ideas and information verbally and in writing for varying audiences.
Initiative – evidence that they take initiative at suggesting improvements and anticipating the needs of leadership, program stakeholders and team members.
Organizational Skills – able to handle multiple simultaneous work deliverables and prioritize them accordingly.
Delivery Mindset – has a delivery mindset with a bias for action, curiosity to learn, challenge, and enhance processes.
Expert Analytical Skills – able to assemble data and analyze patterns, trends and draw conclusions and recommendations; rely on data to guide decisions.
Financial Management Experience - managing project budgets between $250K to $3M and comprised of internal and external labor.
Knowledge of and experience working in software delivery lifecycle methodologies (e.g., Agile/ Scrum, Waterfall, etc.)
Experience in demand & capacity management
Proficiency with:
Project planning tools such as: MS Project, Azure DevOps (ADO) Boards, or similar
Clarity PPM for project financial and status reporting (or similar)
Collaboration tools such as: Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), MS Teams
Reporting tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, or similar data reporting and analytics tools.

A College or University degree; MBA or relevant advance degree a plus.
Current PMP certification strongly preferred.

Work Authorization

Applicants must have the right to work in the United Kingdom at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role. This includes Skilled Worker visas, Global Business Mobility routes, Graduate visas, Youth Mobility Scheme, High Potential Individual visas, Scale-up Worker visas, Temporary Worker visas, and other employer-sponsored visa categories.

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

new_jobs.title: Senior Scaling Operations Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

Read our blog to learn more.

About The Role...

Scaling Operations is Duolingo’s 1-to-a-billion function. We turn promising ideas into reliable, scalable systems so teams can move faster without multiplying headcount or complexity. As a Senior Scaling Operations Program Manager, you’ll be an embedded operational and strategic partner who owns cross-functional programs from ambiguity to impact. You will design and run workflows, align engineering, product, and content partners, and measure what matters so we can launch faster, scale smarter, and increase quality with less effort. This role is based in Pittsburgh, PA or New York City, NY.

🧠 You will...

Lead high-leverage, cross-functional programs from definition through launch and scale, creating clarity in ambiguous problem spaces and driving decisions across stakeholders in Engineering, Learning & Curriculum, and Product.
Design and implement durable, tech-forward workflows and standards that reduce manual effort and enable reliable, repeatable execution at scale.
Orchestrate execution across multiple teams, sequencing dependencies, managing risk, and establishing SLAs, KPIs, and operating cadences that keep programs on track.
Build decision frameworks and business cases that balance impact, scale, cost, complexity, and confidence; model tradeoffs and recommend paths forward.
Shrink “time to launch” and “time to scale” by introducing process improvements, documentation, and tooling that pave the road behind each release.
Partner closely with engineering to mature systems for stability, observability, and resilience; define specs and roadmaps where needed to support scale.
Align functions early and often to surface risks, close context gaps, and reduce surprises; serve as the connective tissue enabling fast, confident delivery.
Measure outcomes rigorously and iterate: set success metrics, run post-launch assessments, and turn bespoke wins into adaptable workstreams.

✅ You have...

Experience in program or operations management leading complex, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end in product, platform, content, or operations domains.
A track record of designing and scaling systems or workflows that improved speed, quality, and efficiency across multiple teams or markets at the scale of millions of users.
Demonstrated ability to create clarity from ambiguity, drive alignment without authority, and make sound, ROI-focused decisions.
Strong operational rigor: you set clear goals, define SLAs/KPIs, manage risk and dependencies, and communicate crisply with executives and partners.
Technical fluency partnering with engineering to shape specs, roadmaps, and tooling for scale; comfortable with data to inform prioritization and tradeoffs.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and experience working with stakeholders across Engineering, Learning & Curriculum, Product, and Finance.
The ability to work from or relocate to Pittsburgh, PA or New York City, NY.

⭐ Exceptional candidates will have...

Experience rapidly scaling operations or content across many languages, markets, or products, with measurable improvements in time-to-launch, time-to-scale or quality.
Proven wins turning 0-to-1 programs into durable systems, including establishing evaluation loops, automation, or expert workflows.
Experience building decision frameworks that enabled shifts to new operating models or technologies (e.g., AI-assisted scaling) with clear cost/quality outcomes.
Background working at the intersection of engineering, content, and product, maturing systems for reliability and observability at scale.

The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!

Salary Range

$142,800—$193,200 USD

Benefits:
Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits here.

Job Alerts:
Sign up for job alerts here.

We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com.

Equal Employment Opportunity:
Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

new_jobs.title: Sr. IT Project Manager -  IT Construction
new_jobs.description:
At Curaleaf, we’re redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

Title: Sr. IT Project Manager - IT Construction

Location: Stamford, CT (On-site)

Job Type: Full-Time, Exempt

About the Role:

We are actively seeking a talented and experienced Sr. IT Project Manager to lead and manage a wide variety of IT projects from conceptual design through implementation. You must possess organizational skills, leadership capability, and communication skills to succeed in this role. You will coordinate with internal delivery teams and vendors as we design, develop, deploy, and support internal custom solutions and third-party platforms. This role serves as the primary IT project lead supporting new location openings, expansions, remodels, acquisitions, and infrastructure deployments for corporate, retail and operations facilities across multiple states. The position bridges IT, construction, facilities, retail operations, compliance, asset protection, marketing operations, and third-party vendors to ensure locations are technology-ready for inspection, licensing, and commercial operation. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with various project management methodologies and a proven track record of successfully delivering IT projects supporting digital and organizational transformation programs and operating in a highly regulated, multi-state environment.

What You’ll Do:

Drive key components of our organization's digital transformation program, ensuring alignment with strategic business and technology objectives
Lead multiple concurrent IT projects from initiation through hypercare and project close down
Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, including scope, schedule, budget, risks and quality
Apply appropriate methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Scrum) based on project requirements
Facilitate key project meetings and steering committee updates, managing cross-functional stakeholder relationships across IT, the business and external partners
Prepare and deliver clear, concise executive and steering committee reporting, including RAG status, milestone tracking, and risk visibility
Manage project budgets and resource allocation to ensure optimal utilization
Resolve team impediments and collaborate with other Project Managers/Scrum Masters
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks to ensure successful delivery
Mentor junior project managers and provide team leadership
Collaborate with cross-functional, stakeholders, and vendors

What You’ll Bring:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Business, or related field
7+ years of progressively responsible IT project management experience, including infrastructure deployments, retail technology implementations, construction-related programs, or multi-site technology rollouts.

PMI-PMP, CSM, or equivalent certifications

Expert knowledge of project methodologies and frameworks (PMBOK, Waterfall, Agile, Scrum)

Experience leading projects within digital transformation initiatives or significant organizational change programs

Experience with Azure DevOps suite or equivalent tool set

Proficiency with ServiceNow SPM / CWM, MS Project, MS Project Web App and Office 365 suite

Proficient understanding of SDLC with focus on agility, quality, and security

Demonstrated ability to manage project scope, timeline, and budget

Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills

Experience managing vendor relationships, SOWs, and third-party delivery teams

Even Better If:

Experience operating within a regulated industry (e.g., cannabis, pharmaceutical, healthcare, CPG) with familiarity managing regulatory, GxP, or multi-state compliance requirements within IT projects
Experience managing technology workstreams associated with facility construction, remodel, relocation, or expansion projects.
Experience with data privacy and security frameworks (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA) as applied to project delivery
Experience operating within a formal PMO governance model with defined phase gates and executive steering committees

Connecticut Hiring Range

$145,000—$161,000 USD

What We Offer:

About ECI

ECI’s mission is to be the global leader of professional consulting services for the life sciences industry. The ideal candidate will manage Manufacturing Software and Sourced Finished Medical Device software-related workstreams within a medical device integration program. The role will support internal manufacturing software, supplier-managed software activities, software distribution, validation, release planning, production readiness, and transition-to-sustainment activities. This individual will work directly with internal cross-functional teams and SFMD supplier partners to align deliverables, dependencies, risks, documentation, and execution plans. The contractor will partner with Software Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supplier Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, Cybersecurity, IT, and external supplier organizations to ensure software activities are completed in accordance with applicable medical device quality system requirements and software lifecycle standards. Lead planning and execution of the Non-Product Software workstream across Manufacturing Software and SFMD software activities to support product integration and new product development efforts.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestone schedules, and project risks, and release plans.

Coordinate requirements, design inputs, validation planning, test evidence, release readiness, deployment planning, and production support handoffs.

Track objective evidence and documentation deliverables required for software release, manufacturing implementation, medical device manufacturing integration, and sustainment transition.

Partner with other project managers, leads, and functional stakeholders to clarify priorities and remove blockers.
Drive continuous improvement in Agile operating cadence, team accountability, and delivery predictability

What You Will Bring

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or related technical discipline.

Experience with manufacturing systems, software distribution, configuration management.

The Global Product Team is responsible for all aspects of product development and design from ideation through production. The team leads the company’s largest product initiatives through the creation, development, and testing of innovative, high-quality goods that will be sold to and experienced by customers all over the world.

Within the Product Team, the Program Management team is responsible for overall program scoping, driving cross-functional teams to define and execute development and design strategy, and ensuring all workstreams ladder up successfully to launch new products.

We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented leader who thrives in ambiguity and loves making things happen. This is an ideal role for someone eager to own big outcomes and grow within a fast-moving product organization.

As a Product Program Manager, you’ll lead cross-functional workstreams and teams at all levels through thoughtful planning, execution, and support from concept through product launch. Collaborate across product development, marketing, sourcing, operations, quality, finance, design, and sales to move work forward quickly and efficiently
Work with domestic and international suppliers and manufacturers throughout development
Clearly communicate updates, blockers, and decisions to stakeholders, including senior leadership, tailoring messages to different audiences
Identify and implement workflow, tool, or process improvements that enable faster, more efficient execution

Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years experience in roles that require ownership, coordination, and execution. This can include rotational programs, operations, finance, or product development. Industry experience in CPG, startups, or fast-paced environments a plus but not required

You communicate clearly and confidently across stakeholders, internal and external, senior and peer-level
You identify problems, own solutions, and take pride in driving outcomes rather than simply completing tasks
You build trust quickly across teams, balancing input from multiple stakeholders while staying focused on the goal
You are curious, adaptable, and resilient in the face of ambiguity, shifting priorities, or unexpected challenges
You bring a positive outlook and a sense of humor. We take our work seriously and ourselves less so

Working closely with Product Development, Package Development, Marketing, Global Supply, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Sales, and Design teams as well as external supplier/vendor partners

new_jobs.description:
About Us

We are specialists in designing, delivering, and supporting all aspects of Customer Experience Technology globally. This might be Digital Signage, LCD and LED Displays, Mobile Technology, Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality and Virtual Try-On solutions that enhance the retail experience for shoppers and deliver incremental revenues and loyalty for our customers. Our work is featured in key verticals like Retail, Hospitality, Healthcare, Financial Services, DOOH, and Government. We deliver best-in-class hardware, software, and support solutions to our clients that include digital signage, interactivity, wayfinding, content management software, custom solutions, and an advanced support and analytics platform. We are a global provider of digital signage and engagement solutions.

Overview

The Technical Project Manager owns the technical onboarding of new clients and networks onto GSL’s XEN platform (XEN CMS, XEN Media, and XEN NOC) and manages the ongoing delivery of platform projects for the digital signage and Digital Out of Home (DOOH) industries. This is a hands-on role: you will run client migrations from legacy content management systems, configure players, networks, inventory, and scheduling in XEN, coordinate directly with our software vendors and engineering partners, and be the client’s primary technical point of contact from kickoff through hand-off to our NOC and support teams.
You will coordinate between internal business units, external vendors, and clients to define scopes of work and project timelines, and to align business requests and requirements against technical specifications. You will own the end-to-end project lifecycle, act as the client-facing liaison when scoping platform feature changes or requests, and create the documentation and training our NOC and support staff rely on once an implementation has gone live.

This role typically carries three or more concurrent client onboardings and platform projects at once, each with its own stakeholders, vendors, and timeline. Strong organization, disciplined follow-through, and clear written communication are essential.

As the role is a front-line interface for our organization with clients, a strong history of creating positive and productive interactions with customers is required. Previous experience in digital signage, content management systems, Out of Home media, or the A/V industry is a strong plus.

Duties and Responsibilities

Client Onboarding & Migration

•     Own the technical onboarding of new clients and networks onto XEN CMS, XEN Media, and XEN NOC, from kickoff through go-live and hand-off to support
•     Plan and execute migrations from third-party or legacy CMS platforms (e.g., Broadsign, Scala, or in-house systems) to XEN, including player conversion, playlist and layout recreation, and cutover scheduling that minimizes on-screen disruption
•     Gather and validate client network data: screen inventory, locations, sell sheets, spec sheets, resolutions, dayparts, and loop structures, and load it into the platform accurately using bulk import tools
•     Configure and validate media players, network connectivity, content distribution, and monitoring so screens report correctly into XEN NOC before go-live
•     Set up campaigns, creatives, and creative scheduling in XEN Media and the CMS, and train client teams (sales, ad ops, traffic) to manage their own inventory, proposals, and campaign scheduling going forward
•     Establish proof-of-play, compliance reporting, and programmatic connections (SSP integrations) as part of onboarding where applicable
•     Run structured client kickoffs, weekly status cadences, and go-live checklists, with accurate notes, action items, and owners captured and distributed after every session

Project & Platform Delivery

•     Manage the end-to-end project lifecycle of our technology platform offerings
•     Create project timelines and ensure commitments against timelines are met; escalate risks early with options rather than after the fact
•     Create and/or manage SOWs, user workflows, design guidance, and ensure commitments against functionality deliverables are met
•     Coordinate, collaborate, and lead between stakeholders, including internal business units, clients, and vendors
•     Act as one of the primary points of contact with clients and hold cadence updates on ongoing progress
•     Translate client feature requests and pain points into clear, prioritized requirements for engineering and vendor teams; track them through delivery and confirm outcomes with the client
•     Manage day-to-day relationships with platform and development vendors: log defects and feature requests, track SLAs and open tickets, hold vendors to committed dates, and drive workarounds when vendor delivery slips
•     Contribute to future product ideas, R&D, and feedback over the course of learnings with our clients and opportunities
•     Identify areas of improvement and any risks involved from a competitive, legal, and technical nature

Documentation, Training & Support Transition

•     Create documentation, runbooks, and training for our NOC and support teams to take over support post-go-live, including client-specific configurations, escalation paths, and known issues
•     Maintain onboarding templates, checklists, and standard operating procedures so each new client onboarding is faster and more consistent than the last
•     Assist in training for our customers
•     May be required to work outside of business hours to coordinate with vendors and clients located outside of the United States (e.g., UK, Europe, and Asia time zones)

Skills and Qualifications

Required

•     5+ years of experience in project management, with a track record of running multiple concurrent client-facing technical projects involving different business units, external vendors, and clients
•     5+ years of experience in a customer-facing role; comfortable being the accountable technical contact for a client
•     Hands-on technical background: able to work directly in a CMS, configure media players or endpoint devices, read logs, work with APIs and CSV/bulk data, and troubleshoot connectivity and playback issues without waiting for engineering
•     Experience onboarding or migrating customers onto a software platform, ideally including data migration and cutover planning
•     Well organized with strong time management; able to coordinate and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously without letting details drop
•     Communicates effectively, both verbally and in writing, with the ability to summarize complex issues for technical and non-technical audiences, including senior client stakeholders
•     Meticulous meeting hygiene: accurate notes, clear action items, awareness of time zones, and professional conduct on client calls and screen shares
•     Problem solver and solution-oriented; comfortable working through ambiguity and vendor gaps
•     Professional behavior that enhances productivity and promotes teamwork and cooperation with colleagues and clients
•     Interfaces effectively with individuals at all levels of the organization and outside the organization

Preferred

•     Experience with digital signage CMS platforms (Navori, Broadsign, Scala, BrightSign, or similar) and DOOH media platforms (ad serving, inventory management, proposal generation, proof-of-play)
•     Familiarity with programmatic DOOH (SSPs such as Vistar, Perion, Place Exchange) and industry standards such as VAST
•     Working knowledge of SQL, REST APIs, basic scripting, and cloud environments (Azure preferred)
•     Understanding of LED/LCD display hardware, media players, and network fundamentals (IP, DNS, firewalls, LTE connectivity)
•     Experience working with development vendors and managing sprint-based delivery
•     Knowledge of PSA/ticketing and project tools such as ConnectWise or Atlassian (Jira/Confluence)
•     PMP, CAPM, or Agile/Scrum certification
•     Associate or advanced degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field

Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented, thorough, and organized Project Manager (PM) to join our growing team. In this position, you will oversee financial budgets, coordinate subcontractors, and manage the construction process to meet contractual requirements. You will also organize schedules, track inventory, and oversee material ordering. Project Managers work in many areas of development and are responsible for managing a project from start to finish. Their duties include putting together a project schedule, hiring subcontractors, negotiating contracts, and obtaining permits.

PMs supervise construction, repair, and design-build projects from beginning to end, ensuring that projects are completed within time and budgetary constraints. An understanding of the construction business and the ability to work under deadlines in a fast-paced environment are important for career success. PMs control the time, cost, and quality of construction projects awarded by government, commercial, and industrial clients. They plan and coordinate all aspects of the construction process, including hiring subcontractors and working with engineers, architects, vendors, field personnel, logistics professionals, and others to complete all aspects of the projects within quality, time, and budgetary constraints. PMs are therefore responsible for keeping assigned projects on track. They must possess the ability to not only manage current situations as they arise, but also anticipate future challenges to resolve issues before they become problems.

Coordinate inspection and oversight of the Client’s Quality Assurance Representative to minimize project delays.

At Credence, we support our clients' mission-critical needs, powered by technology. We practice servant leadership and believe that by focusing on the success of our clients, team members, and partners, we all achieve greater success. 
Credence has an immediate opening for an FMS Program Manager who will be primarily responsible for supporting the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center WAM (AFLCMC/WAM) directorate, F-16 division at Wright Patterson AFB, OH. 
F-16 "Viper" AFLCMC/WAM is headquartered at Hill Air Force Base with units located at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Tyndall Air Force Base, Eglin Air Force Base, and Davis-Monthan Air Force Base.  The F-16 "Viper" is a multi-role fighter jet delivering air-to-air, air-to-ground, and surveillance capabilities for the United States Air Force (USAF) and Coalition Partners.
The F-16 program has the largest Foreign Military Sales (FMS) program in U.S. history producing over 4,500 jets for 24 countries.  Each F-16 FMS case is uniquely tailored to country requirements / development / funding.  Presently, FMS production orders exist through 2030. Additionally, the F-16 program includes the Multi-National Fighter Program (MNFP). MNFP is not a typical FMS program, but a unique, cooperative USAF and development program implemented through the FMS process under the framework of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU). MNFP began in 1975 with the countries of Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Norway; Portugal joined in 200.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the duties listed below:

Support the planning and organizing of program/project activities and analysis and perform professional or technical work related to program management.  The Contractor shall assist to plan, organize, complete, and present assessments of program/project management concepts, analyses, studies, and procedures.   The Contractor shall assist to evaluate implications of existing or proposed projects, programs, processes, and policies/laws and recommend improvements.
Provide support and technical expertise for various F-16 FMS programs in all DoW acquisitions stages to include planning, execution, delivery, sustainment and program closure IAW DoW policies and guidelines.
Provide support with the monitoring, reviewing, analyzing and coordination of security assistance issues concerning DoW and non-DoW agencies to ensure compliance with established policies, Letters of Request (LORs), and Letters Of Offer and Acceptance (LOAs), the Foreign Assistance Act, the Arms Export Control Act (AECA), and other relevant legislation. 
 provide support with the implementation and execution of assigned LOAs IAW the AECA, Security Assistance Management Manual (SAMM) as Defense Security Cooperation Agency (DSCA) Manual 5105.38-M and complete assigned projects with no or minimal assistance.

Assist with reviews of various documents, export licenses, or other documentation submitted by Contractors for Government review and assist with release and coordination of Government responses. 
Provide project management for FMS LOA and Manpower Requirements Package (MRP) modifications and amendments. 
Assist to analyze manpower needs for F-16 aircraft according to the LOR from country and LOA.
Assist to monitor the funding status and track expiring positions in coordination with Project Managers and Security Assistant Program Managers (SAPMs) to allocate and extend positions with country concurrence. 
Support SAPMs, line managers, and functionals across all phases of the acquisition process and assist to provide insight into areas relating to acquisition policy, streamlining, management, and lessons learned. 
Assist to ensure requirements are identified to provide initial support for new acquisitions or modifications of weapon systems until transitioned to sustainment. 
Provide support with actions necessary to award contracts to include pre-award documentation and assist in the evaluation of proposals submitted in response to a Government Request for Proposals (RFP) from weapon system Contractors. 
Provide support in the coordination of resources (FM, management, procurement, engineering, and logistics) and the consolidation of their inputs into common documents
Assist in planning for the accomplishment of various program milestones. 
Provide support in the preparation of briefing charts to support meetings.
Review briefings, documents, and correspondence to ensure content accuracy as it relates to various DoW acquisition-related documents and provide comments and recommendations.
Assist in the preparation of correspondence to other USG agencies, Contractors, and foreign governments/ customers. 
Support the Government at various meetings both Continental United States (CONUS) and Outside Continental United States (OCONUS) including, but not limited to, program reviews, team management reviews, design reviews, financial and production readiness reviews, and TIMs at various levels of the Government and other Contractor organizations.  
Provide support to manage coordination and suspense control activities for inquiries from higher HQ, prepare responses for senior officials' approval, and provide recommendations to senior management for dispositions. Contractor shall assist to collect, process, and prepare analysis of metrics in response to taskings received from internal and higher-level management sources.

Assist to maintain and update project management documents, develop standard operating procedures, perform financial and risk management, and develop and maintain an Integrated Master Schedule (IMS). 
Provide support with LOA line management and LOA FMS budget development, financial tracking, deliverables execution, and interface with senior USG FMS representatives as required. 
Provide support with the preparation of Price and Availability (P&A) data, LOA data, and budgetary Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) estimates for new FMS programs, and follow-on support cases.

Position Summary

The Project Manager at Susser Bank will be responsible for planning, executing and delivering multiple projects that support banks technology strategy. The PM acts as the central coordinator between business leaders, technology teams, vendors, and different stakeholders within the bank to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, within budget, and in compliance with banking regulations. The ideal candidate has proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, with a solid understanding of both Waterfall and Agile ways of working. They are adaptable and capable of leading small, medium, and large-scale initiatives, effectively tailoring their approach based on project complexity, stakeholder needs, and delivery methodology.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

Project Planning & Initiation

Define project scope, objectives, success criteria, and delivery approach (Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid).
Develop and maintain an integrated project plan that outlines milestones, timelines, dependencies, and resource needs.
Ensure alignment between business goals, technical approaches, and regulatory considerations.

Execution & Delivery Management

Lead day‑to‑day execution of the project plan, ensuring work progress as scheduled.
Coordinate internal teams, external vendors, and stakeholders to keep delivery on track.
Adapt delivery rigor based on project size, risk, and complexity.
Ensure deliverables meet agreed‑upon quality standards.

Track vendor dependencies, deliverables, and risks.

Security or regulatory-driven technology changes

Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

PMP (Project Management Professional) – PMI.
Certified ScrumMaster (CSM).
Experience with Office 365 administration and enterprise collaboration platforms.

new_jobs.title: East Area Development Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Key Responsibilities

Employee Contract Type:
Open-ended contract

Location:
Based in Khentii province

Reports to
Opeartions Director.

The Area Development Program (ADP) Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight of integrated development programmes across assigned geographic areas, ensuring effective programme design, implementation, monitoring, learning, and adaptive management in alignment with World Vision Mongolia’s strategy and the Future Ready Sponsorship (FRS) model. The position leads FRS implementation by strengthening sponsorship integration, community engagement, evidence-based decision-making, and programme quality through the Adaptive Programming Approach (APA). The ADP Manager oversees a multi-sectoral programme portfolio that integrates child well-being, child protection, education, livelihoods, resilience, disaster risk reduction, and GEDSI principles, while building strong partnerships with government, communities, donors, sponsors, and other stakeholders. The role provides leadership in programme management, people development, resource stewardship, and accountability, ensuring programmes remain responsive to evolving needs and contribute to sustainable outcomes for vulnerable children and communities. The position fosters cross-functional collaboration and ensures that all work reflects World Vision’s core values: Christ-centred, child-focused, and community-empowering.

20% Leadership & Strategic Management

Contributes to the planning and implementation of World Vision Mongolia’s East Region development programmes by co-developing and implementing issue-based projects and initiatives.
Manages the alignment of Child Sponsorship programming with Global Centre’s and Support offices' new strategic initiatives, including the Future Ready Sponsorship (FRS), by integrating core elements such as EWV, CP, and GEDSI, Adaptive Program Approach, Sponsorship initiatives (SI) into Area Development Program operations and planning.
Provides strong and positive leadership to the Area Development Program, ensuring competent and motivated staff are hired and retained, and high-performers are identified and nurtured.
Supports professional and personal development of Area Development Program staff, emphasizing on-the-job coaching and facilitating ongoing action learning and reflection.
Lead annual staff development planning for alignment with National office competency frameworks, and hold regular performance conversations in line with World Vision’s processes.
Serve as a role model in living out the Witness to Jesus Christ policy, demonstrating Christ-centred leadership to the ADP team.

20% Program and project management

Lead staff coordinating with Technical Program Coordinators in planning and implementing technical programs in the ADP and ensuring scope, quality, budget, and schedule are met as per plan
Lead Development Facilitators in developing Individual Plans for their Target Areas, monitor progress and inform the Operations Director on critical issues, and implement the decisions
Analyse Technical program and Community Engagement and Sponsorship Program guidelines, Plans, implementation processes, and progress in the Area Development Programs, and inform the Operations Director on critical issues with recommendations for collaborative decision-making with NO specialists.
Analyse problems of the community along with the Development Facilitator and develop plans on sustainability, crosscutting elements, disaster risk reduction, and advocacy.
Ensure Most Vulnerable Children assessment and mapping are done within the program area and ensure their involvement and benefit from technical project interventions/ models.
Conduct reflections and analyses of implementation mechanisms for developing/adopting/sharing best practices, Lessons learned, Innovations, and Changes in the Projects and Project management approaches

20% Accountability and quality assurance

Appropriate estimation, allocation, coordination, spending, and distribution of all program resources, including monetary resources.
Program effectiveness is regularly assessed and evaluated to ensure follow-up on program review/audit.
Promote World Vision International’s core values of stewardship throughout the Area Program and Operations areas.
Guide inclusive consultations (e.g., Indabas, CWB consultations), ensuring the meaningful participation of communities, especially the most vulnerable groups.
Apply standard WV planning tools such as the Area Development Programme Plan Template, Partnership Agreement Checklist, and context monitoring tools.
Lead community needs assessments, stakeholder mapping, and vulnerability analysis using templates like the DMEAL Assessment and Design Template.
Use real-time data to guide programming decisions; ensure frequent reviews and learning loops (e.g., Community Review and Planning meetings).
Child Protection Leadership: Facilitate the formation and strengthening of CP Partner Groups; ensure safeguarding systems are in place and functioning.
GEDSI Competency: Promote gender equality, disability inclusion, and social inclusion across all programmatic work. Apply GEDSI-sensitive analysis, inclusive planning, and risk management.
Empowered Worldview (EWV) Facilitation: Equip community champions and integrate faith-based empowerment activities and messaging into programme delivery.

15% Liaison/ Networking

Develop and maintain strong relationships with major (government/private) donors and World Vision Support Offices
Build and maintain strategic partnerships with government agencies, civil society organizations, faith-based groups, and community leaders across multiple provinces to enhance programme impact, advocacy, and sustainability.
Effectively represent World Vision’s identity, values, and programming approach to diverse audiences, including local communities and government actors, to co-develop shared projects and foster local ownership and sustainability.
Assess and strengthen partners’ institutional and technical capabilities (e.g., using BUILD tools).
The ADP Manager leads local advocacy efforts aligned with World Vision Mongolia’s strategy, ensuring priorities like child protection, sanitation, ENOUGH, and climate resilience are integrated across programs and drive policy change.

10% Resource acquisition

Actively contribute to the development of new projects by sharing proven local best practices, exploring innovative methodologies, and recommending priority target areas.
Coordinate multi-sector and multi-funded programme planning in alignment with global models, sponsorship requirements, and donor commitments.
Contribute to donor engagement, resource acquisition, and fundraising efforts through proposal development, programme evidence, and knowledge sharing.

10% Reporting and Knowledge Management

Timely submission of Area development programs’ reports, compiling staff reports, and providing information for annual/ semi-annual reporting to the Support Office
Share AIM assessment results with local stakeholders annually and ensure that priority indicators requiring improvement are incorporated into annual planning and implementation for targeted action.
Ensure program quality through effective use of Partnership systems (e.g., iMPAQ)
Ensure financial reports and explanations of Technical Programs are adequately prepared and reported
Lead the process of continuous learning of Area development programs staff on the Adaptive Program Approach (APA), TD principles, and TD core elements such as EWV, CP, and GEDSI, program quality, humanitarian action, and development aspects.
Capture the program information and success stories, best practices, and lessons learnt. Communicate World Vision’s identity, mission, vision, values, and our approach to work in contextually appropriate ways

5% Other responsibilities

To support the spiritual well-being and development of team members, the ADP manager will implement regular devotional times, team prayer, and spiritual retreats while modeling servant leadership and spiritual maturity in your day-to-day interactions.
Actively participate in relevant capacity-building initiatives (online or in-person) and spiritual development activities such as devotions and chapels.
Perform other duties as assigned by the Operations Director to support the overall mission and effectiveness of World Vision Mongolia
Required Education, training, license, registration, and/or Certification
University degree in Social Science, Business Administration, or related fields
Project management certification is preferred
Strong understanding of child-focused and community-based development principles and practices.

Required Professional Experience

Minimum 3-5 years’ work experience in Program/Project Development with a thorough understanding of all areas of program/project management cycles in a complex context or international organization.
Experience in a leadership role of at least 2-3 years
Experience in managing and coordinating development programmes across multiple geographic areas, including collaboration with local government authorities, community stakeholders, and partners.
Experience in using evidence, learning, and adaptive management approaches to improve programme quality, strengthen local systems, and achieve sustainable outcomes for children.

Willing to travel locally as tasks require 40-50%

new_jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Unity's Entertainment CRO org is the growth and customer engagement engine for our Games and Entertainment customers. Within it, the Operations group exists to bring analytical rigor to how we set strategy and make decisions, ensure every customer-facing team is equipped to execute, and modernize how we engage with customers at scale.

We are hiring a Senior Business Operations Manager to modernize how our sales, success, support, and enablement functions run. Your job is to diagnose why a process isn’t working and design something better. The right answer is sometimes a redesigned process flow, and sometimes automation, a new system capability, or an AI-powered experience. You will take the reins on implementation and see it through. Sometimes, you will need to build automations and internal tools yourself and scale the larger ones with systems and data teams.

What you’ll do

Lead the implementation of AI-driven customer support experience, from designing the customer journey, managing the Help Center experience, to the implementation of customer support AI chatbot
Establish a structured feedback loop between support and relevant product teams that surfaces recurring issues and drives resolution at the root cause
Ensure customer-facing teams are ready for new product and feature launches, including liaising with product teams to update the support knowledge base and address emerging customer issues, and planning training in collaboration with enablement
Partner with support leaders to establish a process for maintaining the Knowledge Base that optimizes for self-service, AI enhancements, and support agent contributions
Drive the technical solutioning for CRM and customer success tooling, from prioritizing features with end users to driving adoption, usage tracking, and gathering feedback
Own the end-to-end design and implementation of a revamped enablement portal for customer-facing teams, in collaboration with GTM enablement, that is easy to use, search, and maintain
Determine the key metrics for customer support and customer success, partnering with data teams on metric definitions, dashboard design, and automated reporting
Build automations and internal tools hands-on, and scale the larger builds in partnership with systems and data teams

What we’re looking for

Strong customer empathy and an appreciation for what makes a customer’s experience easy and seamless
Process- and detail-oriented with proven experience in redesigning operational processes and delivering measurable improvement
Structured thinking, with the ability to take a vague problem and produce a clear diagnosis, a set of options, and a defensible recommendation
Track record of driving cross-functional programs from concept through adoption, working through influence rather than authority
Technical skillsets or strong technical savviness - enough to build simple tooling yourself, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and partner credibly with systems and data teams; hands-on experience with AI coding tools a plus
Data fluency: comfort working with numbers and using evidence to prioritize
Experience with customer support or customer success functions a plus

Promouvoir le savoir-faire de CGI auprès de nos clients et partenaires.
Participer au pilotage des actions d'avant-vente et aux réponses aux appels d'offres.

Développer et maintenir un haut niveau d'expertise dans le domaine de la Data & IA et jouer un rôle de conseil auprès du management sur ces sujets.

Ensemble, en tant que propriétaires, mettons notre savoir-faire à l’œuvre.

Nous vous invitons à devenir propriétaire dès le jour 1 alors que nous travaillons ensemble à faire de notre rêve une réalité. C’est pourquoi nous nous désignons comme associés de CGI, plutôt que comme employés. new_jobs.description:
About The Role

As a Senior Project Manager Application Development, you will make an impact by leading complex application development initiatives that drive business outcomes and deliver value to our clients. You will be a valued member of the delivery team, collaborating with business stakeholders, development teams, vendors, and leadership to successfully execute projects in dynamic environments.

Cognizant will only consider applicants for this position who are legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring Visa transfer or sponsorship now or at any time in the future.

In This Role, You Will

Lead multiple application development projects simultaneously, ensuring on-time delivery, quality execution, and alignment with business objectives.

Manage projects using both Agile (Scrum) and Waterfall methodologies based on project requirements and organizational needs.

Drive project planning activities including scope definition, scheduling, budgeting, forecasting, and resource management.

Partner with cross-functional teams and external vendors to achieve project milestones and deliverables.

Provide clear and proactive stakeholder communication through project status reporting, risk management, and issue resolution.

Monitor project health, identify and mitigate risks, and implement corrective actions to maintain delivery commitments.

Leverage project management tools such as Microsoft Project Plan (MPP), Azure DevOps, and Jira to manage execution and reporting.

Support the adoption of GenAI-enabled project management practices and Portfolio & Project Management (PPM) best practices to improve delivery efficiency and customer experience.

Work model

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 5 days a week in a client office in Peoria, Illinois.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

Proven experience of 12+ years managing application development projects and programs in enterprise environments.

Strong experience delivering projects using both Agile (Scrum) and Waterfall methodologies.

Demonstrated success managing projects within complex multi-vendor environments.

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Project Plan (MPP), Azure DevOps, and/or Jira.

Strong project planning, budgeting, scheduling, risk management, and stakeholder management skills.

Excellent communication and leadership capabilities with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.

Knowledge of GenAI tools and their application to project management and delivery operations.

These will help you stand out

PMP (Project Management Professional) certification.

Experience working in Manufacturing domain

Experience implementing Portfolio & Project Management (PPM) best practices.

Experience leading large-scale digital transformation or application modernization initiatives.

Strong customer-centric mindset with experience improving project outcomes and stakeholder satisfaction.

Note: Certain roles may require candidates to attend in-person interviews at Cognizant offices or client locations, depending on project requirements.

Applications will be accepted until August 28th, 2026.

Salary And Other Compensation

The annual salary for this position is between $102,600 to $ 160,500 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
401(k) plan and contributions
Long-term/Short-term Disability
Paid Parental Leave
Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Drive continuous improvement through trend reporting analysis and metrics management

Consultative skills (ability to understand true customer needs)
Good communications skills
Distinctive problem solving leader
Should have the following personal characteristics: strong leader, professional, hard-charging, detail-oriented, reliable, calm under fire, creative, with a can-do attitude
Automotive/ Medical background experience as required
Proficiency in use of personal computers, Microsoft Office products (Excel, Word and PowerPoint) and e-mail skills required

Bachelor’s degree required (Supply Chain Management or Engineering)
PMP certified professional is desirable
